title: Design: three levels (page, section, card)
why: Jason, 2026-11-19 (set A, approved): the page, a section and a card as one warm hue stepping only in lightness, "soft yet clearly identifiable": page #E4DCC5, section #EDE6D5 (edge #DBD2BA), card #F6F1E4 (his "i like this card color"; edge #E3DBC6, flat). Text boxes and dropdowns share the card colour, as he asked, with a darker edge #8D7E68 (3.5:1) so a box can be found. Tags on cards take the section colour. Tokens in theme-tokens.php (--tv-canvas is the page; new --tv-sec, --tv-sec-edge, --tv-card-edge, --tv-tag, --tv-field-edge); the home page's sections and Get Local's finder become sections; every card on the site, the admin and the Control Board follow the tokens. Replaces css-theme-brand §3's vellum canvas and micro-gradient card (notes in brand.md §4 and the directive). Buttons stay brand brown for now. Contrast: no new failures on home, Get Local, a listing, the admin dashboard or the board.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
Put on staging (3 files); its checks passed.
